title: Moving an Employee Meal Account onto a Different Plan
content:
An employee may move onto a different meal plan without closing the Employee Meal Account, provided they meet the entry gate of the plan they are moving to on length of service, payroll consent and manager approval. That is read off the account's own record before the change is accepted, by the account's reference together with the plan it is held on and the day any earlier change took effect, and the account must stand active or restricted for a change to be worked at all.

## When a change is accepted

A change is accepted during the annual change window printed against the plan in force, or at any time on a recorded life event such as a move between sites, a change of employer programme or a return from long leave.

A change is only accepted once the cooldown printed against the plan in force has passed since the last plan change on this account, and a plan that has never been changed carries no cooldown.

## When it takes effect, and what moves with it

The change takes effect on the basis printed against the plan being moved to — at once, at the start of the next payroll period, or on the first day of the next month — and the administration charge printed against that plan is raised on the account when it takes effect.

From the effective day the whole parameter column of the new plan applies together: ceilings, allowance, payroll terms, overdraft, refunds and closure terms all move at once, and no parameter of the old plan survives.

Allowance lots granted under the old plan keep their own expiry and are spent under the rules they were granted under, so an employee changing plan mid-month does not lose allowance already on the account.

Charges awaiting payroll recovery move with the account and are recovered under the new plan's deduction ceiling from the effective day onward.

## Where the gate is not met

Where the employee does not meet the entry gate of the plan asked for, the change is declined and the highest plan whose gate they do meet is offered instead.

## Basis Q&A

**Does an employee need a life event to change plan?** Not necessarily. A change is accepted inside the annual window printed against the plan in force, and outside it on a recorded life event.

**Does the cooldown bite on an account that has never changed plan?** No. A plan that has never been changed carries no cooldown.

**Which plan's administration charge is raised?** The one printed against the plan being moved to, raised when the change takes effect.
